purpose: Verify binding cardinality and scope evidence between authorization/approval decisions and tool executions without conflating decision identity, tool-call identity, or external-effect truth.

invariants.rule: decision_id and execution/tool_call identity are distinct namespaces; neither may be inferred from the other.
A per_call decision may bind at most one execution.
A standing decision may bind multiple executions, but each execution must independently carry a scope-binding result.
An execution bound to a deny decision is a contradiction.
scope_binding=not_checked is UNRESOLVED, never upgraded to match.
A PASS validates only decision-to-execution binding evidence; it does not prove the external side effect.
